In his freshman season at Georgetown he was named Big East Rookie of the Year. He is considered one of the best underclassmen in college basketball and is considered a future first round pick.[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Greg-Monroe-1109/ Draft Express] On April 17, 2010, Monroe decided to forgo his final two years of college and enter the [[2010 NBA Draft]]."[http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/draft2010/news/story?id=5104754 Georgetown Hoyas Sophomore Greg Monroe entering NBA Draft]". Associated Press. April 17, 2010. ==Early years== Monroe attended [[Helen Cox High School]] in {{city-state|Harvey|Louisiana}}.
